research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Kenota Health is engaged in research and development of a sample collection apparatus for fluid handling of small amounts of sample fluid and loading of a syringe, as described in the title 'Sample collection apparatus.' The abstract details its use as a precise dispense device within instruments such as analytical or point-of-care devices, aligning with the company's focus on next-generation diagnostic tools for allergy testing. Their work centers on improving sample collection and fluid handling in diagnostic applications.

Kenota's diagnostic tools are safe, simple, and offer a cheaper alternative to allergy testing using a thorough non-invasive technology, enabling physicians to improve patient outcomes.
